prompt.description: Base video prompt. When generating for a blueprint node, use that node's data.media.prompt and preserve it after binding the generated asset.

durationSeconds.description: Clip duration in seconds. >15s segmented generation is out of scope for this tool.

generateAudio.description: Ask the provider to synthesize audio.

mode.description: Generation mode; the server validates the matching reference combination.

firstFrameAssetId.description: Registry image asset id used as first_frame.

lastFrameAssetId.description: Registry image asset id used as last_frame (strict mode only).

referenceImageAssetIds.description: Registry image asset ids used as reference_image (ref mode only).

size.description: Kino output size; the Host capability receives the corresponding aspect ratio.

model.description: Optional Kino video model id. Omit to use the server-selected model.

visualStyleKey.description: Kino visual style key returned by list-video-visual-styles.

label.description: Display label for the produced video_clip asset.

requestId.description: Optional opaque client correlation token, persisted in asset metadata without affecting authorization or generation inputs.
